instruction:
You are an electrical and fire-safety interface engineer checking a task-owned synthetic BESS fire, containment, ventilation, and feeder package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. BESS safety, containment, ventilation, and feeder workflows shape the context only: this instance does not run external software or a real source-pack parser.

## Scene

- SSC-17 Product: `SSC-17-LH-04`
- SSC-17 BESS/inverter datasheets: `BESS-SSC17-004`
- SSC-17 SLD/cable schedule: `SLD-SSC17-004`
- SSC-17 battery-room/container layout: `ROOM-SSC17-004`
- SSC-17 fire strategy: `FIRE-SSC17-004`
- SSC-17 ventilation and containment schedule: `VENT-SSC17-004`
- SSC-17 safety memo: `MEMO-SSC17-004`
- SSC-19 Product: `SSC-19-LH-02`
- SSC-19 BESS data sheet: `BESS-19-DATA-02`
- SSC-19 fire strategy: `FIRE-19-STRAT-02`
- SSC-19 ventilation schedule: `VENT-19-SCHED-02`
- SSC-19 containment detail: `CONTAIN-19-DETAIL-02`
- SSC-19 BESS SLD: `SLD-19-BESS-02`
- SSC-19 safety memo: `MEMO-19-SAFETY-02`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| BESS nominal energy | {{ bess_nominal_kwh }} kWh |
| Maximum depth of discharge | {{ max_depth_of_discharge }} |
| Inverter efficiency | {{ inverter_efficiency }} |
| Room volume | {{ room_volume_m3 }} m3 |
| Required air changes | {{ required_air_changes_h }} ACH |
| Fan power density | {{ fan_power_density_kw_m3_s }} kW/(m3/s) |
| Emergency duration | {{ emergency_duration_hr }} h |
| Battery module count | {{ battery_module_count }} |
| Module HRR | {{ module_hrr_kw }} kW |
| Propagation factor | {{ propagation_factor }} |
| Containment rating | {{ containment_rating_kw }} kW |
| Alarm load | {{ alarm_load_kw }} kW |
| Suppression load | {{ suppression_load_kw }} kW |
| Feeder voltage | {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V |
| Feeder length | {{ feeder_length_m }} m |
| Feeder current | {{ feeder_current_a }} A |
| Conductor resistance | {{ conductor_resistance_ohm_km }} ohm/km |
| Maximum voltage drop | {{ max_voltage_drop_percent }} % |

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "usable_bess_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "ventilation_airflow_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "ventilation_fan_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "ventilation_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "design_hrr_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "containment_hrr_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "safety_load_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "safety_energy_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "safety_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "bess-fire-containment-ventilation-feeder-package"
description = "SSC-17/SSC-19 BESS fire containment, ventilation, and feeder metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound BESS fire and feeder metrics from deterministic SSC-17 and SSC-19 task-owned source packs. The template combines usable storage energy, ventilation airflow, HRR containment, safety energy load, feeder voltage drop, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "bess-safety-feeder"
standards = ["BESS safety workflows", "ventilation and containment workflows", "feeder voltage-drop workflows"]
tags = ["electrical", "bess", "fire", "containment", "ventilation", "feeder", "resilience", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.bess_nominal_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "BESS-SSC17-004 nominal energy"
min = 600.0
max = 600.0

[params.max_depth_of_discharge]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-SSC17-004 maximum depth of discharge"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-SSC17-004 inverter efficiency"
min = 0.95
max = 0.95

[params.room_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "ROOM-SSC17-004 battery room volume"
min = 180.0
max = 180.0

[params.required_air_changes_h]
type = "float"
unit = "ACH"
description = "VENT-SSC17-004 required air changes"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.fan_power_density_kw_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "kW/(m3/s)"
description = "VENT-SSC17-004 fan power density"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.emergency_duration_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "FIRE-SSC17-004 emergency duration"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.battery_module_count]
type = "float"
description = "FIRE-SSC17-004 battery module count"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.module_hrr_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "FIRE-SSC17-004 module heat release rate"
min = 45.0
max = 45.0

[params.propagation_factor]
type = "float"
description = "FIRE-SSC17-004 propagation factor"
min = 0.4
max = 0.4

[params.containment_rating_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "FIRE-SSC17-004 containment rating"
min = 500.0
max = 500.0

[params.alarm_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "VENT-SSC17-004 alarm load"
min = 1.8
max = 1.8

[params.suppression_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "VENT-SSC17-004 suppression load"
min = 0.7
max = 0.7

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "SLD-SSC17-004 feeder voltage"
min = 480.0
max = 480.0

[params.feeder_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SLD-SSC17-004 feeder length"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.feeder_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "SLD-SSC17-004 feeder current"
min = 110.0
max = 110.0

[params.conductor_resistance_ohm_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "SLD-SSC17-004 conductor resistance"
min = 0.201
max = 0.201

[params.max_voltage_drop_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "SLD-SSC17-004 maximum voltage drop"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[outputs.usable_bess_energy_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ventilation_airflow_m3_s]
description = "Ventilation airflow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ventilation_fan_power_kw]
description = "Ventilation fan power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ventilation_energy_kwh]
description = "Ventilation energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.design_hrr_kw]
description = "Design heat release rate"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.containment_hrr_margin_kw]
description = "Containment rating minus design heat release rate"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.safety_load_kw]
description = "Ventilation, alarm, and suppression safety load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.safety_energy_required_kwh]
description = "Safety energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.safety_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy minus safety energy required"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]
description = "Three-phase feeder voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]
description = "Maximum voltage drop minus calculated voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when containment, safety energy, and voltage drop margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-17 BESS safety and feeder package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc17_bess_fire_feeder_case"]
